panels.title: Queries per client

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval),
       client_name AS metric,
       sum(queries) AS queries
FROM dns_10m_by_client
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND client_name LIKE ANY (ARRAY[${client:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: From the hourly continuous aggregate, so this stays fast across the full 90-day retention.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100.0 * sum(blocked) / NULLIF(sum(queries), 0) AS "blocked %"
FROM dns_10m_by_client
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND client_name LIKE ANY (ARRAY[${client:sqlstring}])

panels.title: Per-client totals

targets.rawSql:
SELECT client_name AS "client",
       sum(queries) AS "queries",
       sum(blocked) AS "blocked",
       round(100.0 * sum(blocked) / NULLIF(sum(queries), 0), 1) AS "blocked %",
       sum(cached) AS "cached",
       sum(nxdomain) AS "nxdomain",
       round(sum(sum_ms)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(n_ms), 0), 1) AS "avg ms",
       max(max_ms) AS "max ms"
FROM dns_10m_by_client
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND client_name LIKE ANY (ARRAY[${client:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY client_name
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: avg ms is derived from sum_ms/n_ms - the aggregate deliberately stores both rather than an average, because averages cannot be rolled up.

panels.title: Top registrable domains (eTLD+1)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT effective_tldp AS metric, sum(queries) AS value
FROM dns_10m_by_domain
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY effective_tldp
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.description: effective_tldp is public-suffix correct (co.uk, github.io). Computed by blocky's DB writer - no log store can derive this.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval),
       sum(blocked)  AS "blocked",
       sum(cached)   AS "cached",
       sum(resolved) AS "resolved"
FROM dns_10m_by_client
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND client_name LIKE ANY (ARRAY[${client:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Client to domain

targets.rawSql:
SELECT client_name AS "client",
       effective_tldp AS "domain",
       sum(queries) AS "queries",
       sum(blocked) AS "blocked"
FROM dns_10m_client_domain
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND client_name LIKE ANY (ARRAY[${client:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY client_name, effective_tldp
HAVING sum(queries) > 10
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.description: The per-client, per-domain pairing that Prometheus structurally cannot answer - blocky_response_total carries no client label.

list.name: client
list.label: Client
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT client_name FROM dns_10m_by_client WHERE bucket > now() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND client_name <> '' ORDER BY 1;
